$comment: Diagnostic probes dari The Challenger Sale (mapping §3).

probes.text: What insight does your offer teach that the customer doesn’t yet know about their own business?

signal_interpretation.positive: There is a specific insight that changes the customer's perspective — offer value is built through teaching.
signal_interpretation.negative: None — offerings based on generic features/benefits ('innovative, customer-focused') that do not differentiate

probes.text: Reaksi apa yang Anda harapkan dari customer saat mendengar penawaran — setuju total, atau 'hmm, baru kepikiran'?

signal_interpretation.positive: Mengharapkan refleksi/surprise — reframe benar; offer mendefinisikan kebutuhan
signal_interpretation.negative: Mengharapkan persetujuan penuh — itu artinya mengajar di margin; customer sudah tahu dan sudah punya solusi sendiri

probes.text: Which unique strength that only you have does your Offer lead to — and how do you prove it?

signal_interpretation.positive: Specific unique strengths + proof — teaching culminates in 'why choose us', not free consulting
signal_interpretation.negative: Can't answer / generic answer — free consulting; insight will be targeted by competitors

probes.text: If a customer asks for a 20% discount, what is your response?

signal_interpretation.positive: Acknowledge-defer lalu geser ke percakapan value/implications — take control, margin terlindungi
signal_interpretation.negative: Langsung turunkan harga — passive posture; margin erosion, L8.1 terkunci
signal_interpretation.neutral: Menawarkan sesuatu lain tanpa memahami alasan permintaan — setengah benar

probes.text: How many stakeholders need to agree before the deal is finalized — and is your message tailored to each one?

signal_interpretation.positive: Stakeholder terpetakan + pesan per-role (outcome/kekhawatiran masing-masing) — consensus dapat dibangun
signal_interpretation.negative: One uniform message for everyone — consensus does not form, the deal dies midway.

probes.text: Stalled deal: know exactly who/what is holding it up — and what creative ideas have been tried to get it moving?

signal_interpretation.positive: Peta decision process jelas + eksperimen un-stick spesifik — sales innovation
signal_interpretation.negative: Menunggu/mengecek rutin tanpa strategi baru — deal inspection; zombie leads

probes.text: When was the last time you took a position that risked being rejected by a customer — what happened?

signal_interpretation.positive: There is an assertive track record with measurable results — Challenger posture, controlled price pressure
signal_interpretation.negative: Always passive / afraid of losing the relationship — trust is built via likability that doesn't win deals

probes.text: From strong offerings — embedded in the business model, focus on what matters, differentiation, difficult to imitate — which ones do you already have?

signal_interpretation.positive: Specific self-assessment with clear weak areas — echo 10 characteristics VPD; the basis for improvement exists
signal_interpretation.negative: Mengklaim lengkap semua — tidak ada basis assessment
